title: Vampire Chestplate
description: VampirChest adds a special chestplate that grants different abilities depending on the time of day — empowering players at night and revealing them during daylight.
body:
⚔️ Features
+ 🧛 Vampire chestplate with custom name
+ 🌙 Night abilities:
+ Strength II
+ Speed I
+ Invisibility
+ ☀️ Day drawback:
+ Glowing effect (you can’t hide 👀)
+ 🔧 Fully configurable
+ 🔁 Reload command without server restart
+ 💡 Smart material suggestions in command

📦 Commands


```
/vampirchest <material>
```

```
/vampirchest reload
```

Config.yml

```
item:
  name: "&5Вампирский нагрудник"

effects:
  night:
    strength: 2
    speed: 1
    invisibility: true
  day:
    glowing: true

```

You can:

+ change item name
+ disable effects
+ balance gameplay

🧠 How it works

When a player wears the chestplate:

+ At night → gains powerful buffs
+ At day → becomes visible due to glowing

The plugin automatically checks time and applies effects.

🚀 Perfect for
+ Survival servers
+ RPG servers
+ PvP modes
+ Custom game mechanics
